name: Mistvale
description: The region of Mistvale is shrouded in dense mists and frost that have long characterized its name. Of late, these conditions have worsened; the fog’s chill intensifies to lethal levels within its radius, claiming the lives of the unwary. These victims rise as frozen undead, preying upon travelers from Ben’net’s eastern reaches and fueling speculation about the source of this curse. The Tanarean Empire, preoccupied with the cirrus communities and wary of aiding Baleroth’s schemes, neglects Mistvale. Only with the use of magic can one safely navigate its frigid haze. In truth, the Darkall Forces, led by Gullog and the priests of Bás, are the culprits. They’ve erected a sanctuary for Bás, the Goddess of Winter and Death. Their goals are twofold: to extend Bás’ dominion, forge an undead legion, and access the cirrus cities in the mountains where their many ancient artifacts and magic knowledge are stored, which could greatly benefit the Kemets. They are sending incursions of undead to the nearby Plateaus of Eternal Ice, where cirrus warriors and the Arcanum congregate for training, who are now facing the peril of the undead emerging from Mistvale.
